title: Nagata over a Noetherian base
statement:
Every separated finite-type morphism $X\to S$ with $S$ Noetherian
admits a compactification.

proof.text:
Compactify the affine opens from [sk-lem-nagata-sketch-affine-cover].
Induct on $X_r=U_1\cup\cdots\cup U_r$. The overlap
$X_{r-1}\cap U_r$ contains the dense total intersection, so
[sk-thm-nagata-sketch-two-open] compactifies $X_r$ at each step.
The last union is $X$; the empty scheme causes no exception.

lean.statement:
theorem nagataCompactification_of_isNoetherian [IsNoetherian S] (f : X ⟶ S) [IsSeparated f]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] : HasCompactification f
lean.note: Exact existing theorem: IsNoetherian S and IsSeparated f, with finite type expressed as LocallyOfFiniteType f and QuasiCompact f, imply HasCompactification f. Compactification.quasiCompact_openImmersion supplies quasi-compactness of the open immersion for every such compactification, since f is quasi-compact. Both declarations and the compactification definition were read; the theorem source was also confirmed with scompile.py --source.
